ai_analysis.summary: The post promotes a downloadable PDF containing five intermediate and five complex SQL practice questions organized by topic and based on interview patterns and use cases. It targets candidates preparing for data analyst, business intelligence, or SQL developer roles. The supplied content does not include the actual questions, SQL topics, query examples, or solutions, so no technical SQL concept can be evaluated from it. An opening line lists quality and audit credentials but is unrelated to the SQL promotion.
